  intro x hx
  change f (h x) ∈ ⨅ i, u i
  have hx' : f x ∈ ⨅ i, u i := by
    change f x ∈ ⨅ i, u i at hx
    exact hx
  have hfx : f (h x) = g (f x) := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun k : V →ₗ[F] W => k x) hcomm
  rw [hfx]
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
  intro i
  exact hpres i (f x) (by
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx'
    exact hx' i)

log.message: All goals closed.
